name: convert_timezone_from_logs
description: Convert a timestamp to a timezone
program_code:
import json, sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
args = json.load(sys.stdin)
ts = args['timestamp']
# only handles target tz, no source default
print(json.dumps({'converted': datetime.fromisoformat(ts).astimezone(ZoneInfo(args['target_tz'])).isoformat()}))
